# ScreenHarmony Flex v2.9.1 (Alpha Preview)

Welcome to the **v2.9.1-alpha** testing build of ScreenHarmony Flex! 🚀

### ✨ What's New in this Alpha Release
- **Multi-Step Parent Account Setup**: Seamless onboarding flow requesting Username, Password, and Email with real-time format validation and fast username availability checking.
- **12-Word Master Recovery Phrase**: Step 2 displays a 12-word cryptographic seed phrase with instant one-tap **Copy Phrase** and **Download Key** (exports a `.txt` credential file to Downloads and launches Android Share Sheet).
- **Compact In-App Update Engine**: Clean, unobtrusive update card at the top of Block and Parenting tabs for instant one-click downloads with SHA-256 verification, Obtainium support, and direct GitHub links.
- **Exact Alarm & Schedule Automation**: Full Android 12–14+ support with automatic schedule triggers and auto-rescheduling.
- **Multi-OEM Anti-Tamper Shield**: Intercepts uninstallation and force-close attempts across Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, and Huawei.
- **Background Autostart Resilience**: Play Store compliant OEM background settings deep-linking and persistent sync.
- **Remote Device Wake-Up**: Instant wake triggers with 1-minute freshness validation and real-time connectivity alerts.

### 🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **Resolved Infinite Loading**: Added 3.5s & 6s timeout guards with offline fallback so "Check" buttons and network calls never get stuck loading.
- **Responsive UI Overhaul**: Full keyboard IME padding and vertical scrolling on all parent setup and authentication modals across portrait, landscape, and small-screen phones.
- **Alpha-Only CD Packaging**: Automated CI/CD pipeline now builds and publishes dedicated standalone Alpha APKs.

---
*Note: This is an Alpha preview build intended for testing. Please report any feedback or issues!*
